summary: @ornikar/lerna-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: This scoped package, advertised as a lerna configuration helper, declares a preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") that runs an obfuscator.io-obfuscated setup.mjs. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temporary directory and then execFileSyncs the sibling math_init.js — a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle whose header is `// @bun @bun-cjs` and whose contents are hidden behind a rotated String.fromCodePoint decoder and a large hex constants table. The setup.mjs script itself uses hex-named identifiers (e.g. _0x488df8, _0x52943e) and string-lookup indirection around basic https and exec calls despite having no functional need for obfuscation. A lerna config helper has no legitimate reason to pull a second-language runtime at install time or ship a 727KB obfuscated bundle for it to execute; this is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern that evades Node-based static analysis because the payload only runs under Bun. The behavior does not appear in the upstream ornikar/shared-configs repository for this config package and is consistent with a malicious or compromised release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
